AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

18. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.

21. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Digestive systems of animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Animal Health: Parasite control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
